region.name: the Amberlands
region.blurb: Golden fields in the west, deep forest in the middle, and in the east the smoking peak of Emberpeak.

towns.name: Oakvale
towns.blurb: Everwyn's royal seat: the Queen's castle stands over golden wheat fields.

mayor.title: Duchess
mayor.name: Duchess Marigold
mayor.avatar: plump, cheerful duchess with braided red hair, a green velvet dress, and a wheat-sheaf brooch
greeting: Welcome to Oakvale, Hero! The Queen's messenger said you would come.
We are simple farmers, but we will help however we can.

quest.title: A Letter for Saltmere
offer: Would you carry this letter to Countess Coralie in Saltmere? It is about the harvest fair.
She pays her couriers well, I promise.
quest.reminder: Countess Coralie in Saltmere is waiting for my letter.
done: A letter from Marigold! How lovely. Here, for your trouble.

shop.name: Hilda's General Store

keeper.name: Hilda
keeper.avatar: broad-shouldered shopkeeper with rolled sleeves and a flour-dusted apron

lines: Fresh bread, fresh draughts, fresh advice. What'll it be?

workshop.name: The Royal Workshop

keeper.name: Master Bram
keeper.avatar: grey-bearded master smith in a leather apron stitched with the royal crest

lines: The Queen lets any hero use her workshop. Cauldron, anvil, grindstone: all yours. Pedal hard!

npcs.name: Old Tomas
npcs.avatar: wiry old farmer with a straw hat and a pitchfork
lines: Dragons, eh? My grandfather saw one once.
He said it hated the cold more than anything in the world.

npcs.name: Pip
npcs.avatar: freckled boy with a wooden sword and a helmet three sizes too big
lines: When I grow up, I'm going to fight dragons too!
Did you see the old well? Grandpa says somebody dropped a key down there.

gives.line: Are you a real hero? Mum says heroes always carry healing draughts. Here, take one of mine!

npcs.name: Sergeant Hale
npcs.avatar: grizzled town guard in a dented steel cap, leaning on a halberd
lines: Dragonfire melts ordinary steel. I've seen it.
Arms up, chin down, hit hard. I can train you, for a few coins.

spots.name: the Old Well
spots.text: You haul up the Old Well's bucket. Tangled in the rope is a Rusty Key!

towns.name: Millbrook
towns.blurb: A river town of water-wheels and beehives. The mill never stops turning.

mayor.title: Baron
mayor.name: Baron Tobias
mayor.avatar: stout baron with a bushy black beard and a flour-white waistcoat
greeting: Ah, the Queen's champion! Welcome to Millbrook.

quest.title: The Silver Bell
offer: Our mill's Silver Bell was stolen! We ring it when the river floods.
A goblin ran off toward Thornwood with it. Bring it back and I'll give you my old boots. Enchanted, you know.
quest.reminder: Any sign of the Silver Bell? The goblin ran toward Thornwood.
done: My bell! Now we'll hear the floods coming.
Take these boots. May they carry you far.

shop.name: Millbrook Market

keeper.name: Odo
keeper.avatar: cheerful bald merchant in a honey-colored vest

lines: Honey, hides, and hardware! Best prices on the river.

workshop.name: The Mill Wheel Workshop

keeper.name: Maud
keeper.avatar: cheerful millwright with flour on her sleeves and a spanner in her belt

lines: The river turns my grindstone. For yours, you'll have to pedal!

npcs.name: Beatrix
npcs.avatar: beekeeper in a white veiled hat, bees drifting lazily around her
lines: My bees make the sweetest honey in the Amberlands.
Odo sells it at the market, if you have a sweet tooth. Or know someone who does.

npcs.name: Miller Gus
npcs.avatar: dusty old miller with flour in his eyebrows
lines: That goblin who took our bell went hopping into Thornwood.
Goblins hide their loot in hollow trees. Everybody knows that.

spots.name: the Mill Cellar
spots.text: The Rusty Key turns with a screech. Inside the old chest: a Tome of Might!
spots.lockedText: A heavy chest in the cellar is locked tight. The keyhole is caked with rust.

towns.name: Saltmere
towns.blurb: Salt-white cottages cling to the cliffs above a busy harbor. Gulls cry everywhere.

mayor.title: Countess
mayor.name: Countess Coralie
mayor.avatar: elegant countess with dark curls, a sea-green gown, and a long pearl necklace
greeting: Welcome to Saltmere, Hero. Mind the gulls; they steal.

quest.title: Captain Barnacle
offer: That scoundrel Captain Barnacle robs our merchants on the forest road to Thornwood.
Beat him, and Saltmere will reward you handsomely.
quest.reminder: Captain Barnacle still lurks on the road to Thornwood.
done: Barnacle beaten! The merchants will sing of you.

shop.name: The Barnacle & Pearl

keeper.name: Finn
keeper.avatar: red-haired ex-sailor with a tattooed forearm and a gold earring

lines: Everything the sea washes up, I sell. Mostly.

workshop.name: The Salt & Tar Shed

keeper.name: Corin
keeper.avatar: weathered boatwright with tar-black hands and a coil of rope over one shoulder

lines: Mind the tar pot. Everything else, help yourself.

npcs.name: Old Salt
npcs.avatar: ancient bearded hermit in patched robes that smell of seaweed
lines: Eh? A hero? Heroes never bring me anything sweet.
The shrine in Mirewater sank into the bog long ago. I keep its key. What's it to you?

trade.line: Honey! Millbrook honey! Oh, you dear thing. Here, take the Shrine Key. Mind the frogs.

npcs.name: Fisher Nell
npcs.avatar: weathered fisherwoman in oilskins with a net over one shoulder
lines: The tide brings in all sorts. Pearls, if you look in the tide pools.
Pirates on the Thornwood road, sea-monsters in the old songs. Give me a quiet net any day.

spots.name: the Tide Pools
spots.text: Among the rocks and anemones you find a shining Pearl!

towns.name: Thornwood
towns.blurb: Houses built among giant oaks, joined by rope bridges. The forest is always whispering.

mayor.title: Lord
mayor.name: Lord Fenwick
mayor.avatar: tall, thin lord in a moss-green cloak with a tawny owl on his shoulder
greeting: Thornwood welcomes you. Walk softly; the forest listens.

quest.title: Herbs for Mirewater
offer: A fever has struck Mirewater. Lady Morwenna needs these healing herbs.
Take them to her swiftly. She will reward you, I am sure.
quest.reminder: Please hurry: Lady Morwenna in Mirewater needs those herbs.
done: This ring was my mother's. It will keep you strong.

shop.name: Oakheart Outfitters

keeper.name: Willa
keeper.avatar: wood-elf shopkeeper with leaf-green braids and a quiver on her back

lines: Bows, cloaks, and forest remedies. All handmade.

workshop.name: The Whittled Owl

keeper.name: Fern
keeper.avatar: wood-carver with leaf-green braids and shavings caught in her apron

lines: Bark, sap and elbow grease. The bench is yours.

npcs.name: Zephyr the Wanderer
npcs.avatar: tall wizard in a starry indigo robe and a floppy pointed hat, with a long silver beard and a crooked staff
lines: Tired of that face? I can change it. A little magic, a little gold.
Build, clothes, hair. Nothing I have not done a thousand times.

npcs.name: Ranger Ash
npcs.avatar: hooded ranger with a longbow and a scar across one cheek
lines: The Great Grey Wolf prowls the mountain road between Frostford and Highcrag.
Only a hunt will draw it out. The Earl of Frostford has been asking for one.
I can toughen you up, if you've the coin.

npcs.name: Peddler Mo
npcs.avatar: round peddler under a huge pack hung with pots and trinkets
lines: Goblins, goblins everywhere! One ran past with something shiny.
Straight into the big Hollow Oak by the pond, here in Thornwood.

spots.name: the Hollow Oak
spots.text: Deep inside the Hollow Oak, among goblin junk, something glints: the Silver Bell!

towns.name: Frostford
towns.blurb: Stone houses under deep snow, huddled around a frozen ford. Chimney smoke everywhere.

mayor.title: Earl
mayor.name: Earl Aldous
mayor.avatar: white-bearded earl wrapped in a bearskin cloak, with a silver circlet
greeting: Brr! Come in, come in. Frostford is cold, but its heart is warm.

quest.title: The Great Grey Wolf
offer: A monstrous wolf haunts the mountain road to Highcrag. It has taken our sheep and frightened every trader.
Slay the Great Grey Wolf and I will give you Frostbrand, the ice-blade of my house. It was made for dragons.
quest.reminder: The Great Grey Wolf still prowls the road to Highcrag.
done: The wolf is dead? Then Frostford owes you much.
Take Frostbrand. Its cold never fades. Let Cindermaw feel the winter.

shop.name: The Warm Hearth

keeper.name: Sven
keeper.avatar: huge shopkeeper with a braided blond beard and a fur vest

lines: Furs, flasks, and frost-proof boots. Stay warm, friend.

workshop.name: The Warm Hearth

keeper.name: Olaf
keeper.avatar: huge smith in furs, with steam rising off his bald head

lines: Warmest room in Frostford! Keep that fire roaring and you can make anything.

npcs.name: Smith Greta
npcs.avatar: muscular smith with soot-streaked arms and a leather apron
lines: I forged Frostbrand's new hilt myself. Ice cuts through dragon hide like butter.
Bring me good ore someday and I'll make you something fine.

npcs.name: Scholar Wynn
npcs.avatar: young scholar with ink-stained fingers and round spectacles
lines: Potions obey those who understand them.
I can teach you, for a modest fee.

spots.name: the Frozen Pond
spots.text: A sealed Frost Flask is frozen into the ice at the pond's edge. You chip it free.

towns.name: Mirewater
towns.blurb: Stilt-houses over a green, bubbling bog. Frogs sing day and night.

mayor.title: Lady
mayor.name: Lady Morwenna
mayor.avatar: gray-haired lady in a dark plum dress, carrying a lantern, with kind, tired eyes
greeting: Welcome to Mirewater, Hero. Forgive the smell; it is the bog.

quest.title: A Cure for the Fever
offer: Our children are burning with bog-fever. A Frost Flask would cool them.
They sell them in Frostford, I am told. Bring me one, please.
quest.reminder: A Frost Flask would save our children. Frostford sells them.
done: The fever will break tonight. Thank you.
Take this hat; it was my late husband's. He was a wizard, of sorts.

shop.name: Bogside Curios

keeper.name: Grimble
keeper.avatar: hunched curio dealer with a long nose and a ring on every finger

lines: Potions, poisons, er, remedies. Curios of every kind.

workshop.name: The Bubbling Cauldron

keeper.name: Nell
keeper.avatar: hunched brewer with a long wooden spoon and a necklace of dried frogs

lines: Stir clockwise. Always clockwise. Trust me.

npcs.name: Granny Moss
npcs.avatar: tiny, kindly swamp witch in a mossy shawl, with a toad sitting on her hat
lines: Not all witches are wicked, dearie.
The Tidestone sleeps in the Sunken Shrine. It drinks fire the way the bog drinks rain.

npcs.name: Lem
npcs.avatar: barefoot boy with a net, muddy to the knees and grinning
lines: Ribbit! That's frog for hello.
The shrine's over there, but the gate's locked. Only Old Salt has the key.

spots.name: the Sunken Shrine
spots.text: The Shrine Key turns. Water pours from the gate, and on the altar lies the Tidestone, cool and blue.
spots.lockedText: The shrine's gate is barred and locked. The keyhole is shaped like a wave.

towns.name: Highcrag
towns.blurb: A mining town carved into a cliff. Hammers ring from every tunnel.

mayor.title: Margrave
mayor.name: Margrave Osric
mayor.avatar: broad margrave with a braided brown beard, a miner's helmet, and a heavy gold chain

quest.title: Ore for Frostford
offer: We've struck a new silver seam! Smith Greta in Frostford wants a sample.
Take it to her. She'll pay you for your trouble.
quest.reminder: Smith Greta in Frostford is waiting for that ore.
done: Here, take these, and my thanks.

shop.name: Dunstan's Armory

keeper.name: Dunstan
keeper.avatar: soot-faced armorer with a thick mustache and a hammer on his belt

lines: Steel for heroes. Only the best, and the best isn't cheap.

workshop.name: The High Forge

keeper.name: Brunhild
keeper.avatar: stocky smith with braided hair, soot-streaked arms and a proud grin

lines: Dwarves built this forge, and it has never once gone cold. Strike while it's hot!

npcs.name: Guide Kara
npcs.avatar: wiry mountain guide with a coil of rope and wind-burned cheeks
lines: From here the road to Emberpeak climbs through ash.
The swamp road from Mirewater is longer, and worse.

npcs.name: Miner Pell
npcs.avatar: stocky miner with a lamp on his helmet and coal on his nose
lines: There's an old mine shaft behind the chapel. Nobody's been down in years.
Could be something left in there. Could be bats.

spots.name: the Abandoned Mine
spots.text: In the dark of the old shaft your hand closes on a chunk of Silver Ore.

towns.name: Emberpeak
towns.blurb: A town of red stone beneath a smoking mountain. Most folk have fled; ash drifts like snow.

mayor.title: Duke
mayor.name: Duke Roderic
mayor.avatar: proud young duke with soot on his fine red coat and one arm in a sling
greeting: You've come! The Queen heard us!
Cindermaw lairs in the cave above the town. It burned my hall, and half the town with it.

shop.name: The Last Lantern

keeper.name: Ivy
keeper.avatar: stubborn young shopkeeper with a soot-smudged face and a lantern

lines: I'm staying till the end. Buy what you need; you'll need it.

workshop.name: The Cracked Anvil

keeper.name: Soot
keeper.avatar: soot-covered young smith who refused to flee, with a bucket of water always at hand

lines: Fire's the one thing we have plenty of. Use the forge, and hurry.

npcs.name: Old Bess
npcs.avatar: stooped grandmother in a scorched shawl, clutching an indignant cat
lines: That dragon ate my goat. My GOAT!
Frostbrand, the Dragonscale Shield, and the Tidestone. The old songs say you need all three.

npcs.name: Watchman Cole
npcs.avatar: exhausted young watchman in a singed helmet, holding a bucket
lines: I've been throwing water on fires for a week.
Please tell me you're here to stop it.

spots.name: the Ruined Hall
spots.text: In the ashes of the Duke's hall, one Greater Healing Draught survived the flames.

enemies.name: Grey Wolf
enemies.taunt: A wolf slinks out of the grass, teeth bared.

enemies.name: Wild Boar
enemies.taunt: A boar paws the ground and snorts.

enemies.name: Goblin Scout
enemies.taunt: A goblin cackles and waves a rusty knife.

enemies.name: Cave Bats
enemies.taunt: A swarm of bats pours out of the rocks!

enemies.name: Giant Crab
enemies.taunt: A crab the size of a cart clacks its claws.

enemies.name: Bog Lurker
enemies.taunt: Something scaly rises from the muck.

enemies.name: Marsh Wisp
enemies.taunt: A pale light drifts closer, whispering your name.

enemies.name: Frost Sprite
enemies.taunt: A shivering sprite hurls a snowball. It is mostly ice.

enemies.name: Snow Troll
enemies.taunt: A troll heaves itself out of a snowdrift.

enemies.name: Rock Golem
enemies.taunt: A boulder unfolds into a grinding, rumbling golem.

enemies.name: Fire Imp
enemies.taunt: An imp giggles and juggles little flames.

enemies.name: the Great Grey Wolf
enemies.taunt: A wolf as big as a pony blocks the road. Its eyes are yellow lamps.
enemies.avatar: enormous grey wolf with a torn ear and yellow eyes

enemies.name: Captain Barnacle
enemies.taunt: "Captain Barnacle, at yer service! Now empty yer pockets."
enemies.avatar: barrel-chested pirate captain with a barnacle-crusted peg leg and a parrot

enemies.name: Cindermaw the Red
enemies.taunt: "Another morsel climbs my mountain. Come, little knight. Let me warm you."
enemies.avatar: huge crimson dragon with smoking nostrils, cracked gold horns, and eyes like molten glass

hints.text: Dragons hate the cold. A frost weapon would bite deep.
The Earl of Frostford keeps a blade of living ice called Frostbrand. He'd give it to whoever rids his roads of wolves.
Frostbrand belongs to Earl Aldous of Frostford. He has a task for a hero.
The Great Grey Wolf prowls the road between Frostford and Highcrag.
Dunstan's Armory in Highcrag sells a Dragonscale Shield. It costs a fortune: 240 gold.
Dragonfire melts ordinary steel. Only dragonscale can turn it, and Highcrag's armorer has some.
The Tidestone, a stone that drinks fire, lies in a sunken shrine in the swamps of Mirewater.
Old Salt, the hermit of Saltmere, keeps the key to Mirewater's Sunken Shrine.
With the Tidestone, dragonfire can be quenched. It sleeps in Mirewater's Sunken Shrine.
The Sunken Shrine's gate is locked. Its key went to a hermit who lives by the sea in Saltmere.
The old hermit in Saltmere will trade almost anything for a jar of Millbrook honey.
The goblin who stole Millbrook's Silver Bell hid it in Thornwood's Hollow Oak.
An old chest in the Millbrook mill cellar is locked. The key fell down Oakvale's Old Well years ago.
The quickest road to Emberpeak is the ash road from Highcrag.
To defeat Cindermaw you need Frostbrand, a Dragonscale Shield, and the Tidestone.

challenge.title: The Dragon of Emberpeak
summons: Hero, thank you for coming so swiftly. Grave news has reached the throne.
A dragon, Cindermaw the Red, has woken beneath Emberpeak in the far east of the Amberlands. Its fire has driven the townsfolk from their homes.
Our scholars say three things can bring it down: the ice-blade Frostbrand, a Dragonscale Shield to turn its fire, and the Tidestone, which drinks flame.
Find all three, then face the beast in its lair above Emberpeak. Ask everyone you meet; the people of the Amberlands know more than they think.
Take this purse and these draughts. My carriage will carry you to Oakvale. The kingdom is counting on you.

lair.name: Cindermaw's Lair
lair.text: Heat pours from a cave mouth above the town. Melted shields litter the slope.

victory: You raise the Tidestone and Cindermaw's fire hisses into steam. Frostbrand bites, and bites again.
With a last roar that shakes the mountain, Cindermaw the Red crashes down the slope and moves no more.
The fires of Emberpeak gutter out. The townsfolk creep back, then cheer until they are hoarse.
